description: Nokia 7210 SAS in classic CLI mode, with the alu-conf-r13 YANG models and the CLI content layer.
notes: Verified read-only on 2026-11-07 against the device below: detection from the hello, get-config, the @systemName path, and rpc-errors read as typed RpcErrors with the session kept open. Writes through configure() are untested.

NETCONF on a classic 7210 runs CLI commands internally. The NETCONF user needs CLI access as well (configure system security user <name> access netconf ssh-cli); with only 'access netconf', every command is refused whatever the user's profile says.
The user's profile must permit 'admin' (get-config runs 'admin display-config'). Permitting 'show' is harmless but gains nothing yet.
The device advertises writable-running and no candidate datastore, so changes apply directly to running.

The device turns subtree filters into CLI commands: it enters the filter's context and runs info. A filter must stop at a CLI context: a container such as <system/>, or a list entry selected by its key such as <port><port-id>1/1/1</port-id></port>. Ending at a leaf, or at a container the CLI treats as a value (<system><name/></system>), fails with 'Leaf element specified which is not a key', even with permit-all; a list without its key (<port/>) fails as 'command failed'. So subtreeFilter 'containers' with depth 2 filters read() to /configure/<section> or a keyed entry and selects the rest locally (verified 2026-11-07).

Filtered reads need the user's profile to permit 'configure', 'back', 'info' and 'exit' as well as 'admin'. Without them they fail with 'CLI Command not allowed for this user'; set subtreeFilter 'unsupported' in a profile that extends this one to fetch the whole configuration instead.
<get> returns no state: CLI content layer (cli-show) requests return empty <data/>, and with no ietf-netconf-monitoring there is no get-schema to find the right format.

With no <get-schema>, JSON reads (the default for client.content.read() and readValue()) are converted schema-less, with a warning: values are text, and a list with one entry is not an array. The alu-conf-r13 YANG modules aren't bundled, because Nokia doesn't publish them openly. Take them from the device's software release and give their directory as yang.modules, in connect() or in a profile that extends this one. Alternatively, read with format: 'xml'.
rpc-error messages copy CLI output, including a BEL (0x07) that XML 1.0 does not allow, so the invalidXmlChars quirk strips it.

An empty container is written across two lines, as a line feed and the closing tag's indentation (<access>, 0x0A, 20 spaces, </access>, seen on 2026-11-07). The paddedEmptyElements quirk empties those, so they read as <access/>.

The hello cannot tell a 7210 from other classic-CLI SR OS devices (such as a 7750 in classic mode), so this profile matches those too. When a second classic device is verified, split out a nokia-sros-classic base and extend it.

It advertises with-defaults:1.0 with basic-mode=trim and nothing else, but rejects the <with-defaults> parameter on <get-config> (bad-element, 'Element is not valid in the specified context'), even with its own basic mode (checked read-only 2026-11-07). Reads always use trim; the capability still tells create/delete semantics.
